description.la: De templo Salomonis liber, cum epistola ad Accam.
description.en-US: Bede's exposition of Solomon's Temple (1 Kings 5-8) as the figure of the Church and of each believing soul, with its dedicatory letter to Bishop Acca. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A exposição de Beda sobre o Templo de Salomão (1 Reis 5-8) como figura da Igreja e de cada alma fiel, com a carta dedicatória ao bispo Acca.

sources.edition: De templo Salomonis on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
